your_book:
Tuesday's session was a mixed bag for Jaleel's book, with the overall unrealized position sitting at –2.48%. The brightest spots came from the consumer and retail names: On Holding (ONON) led the day at +3.92%, AutoZone (AZO) posted a solid +3.24%, and Broadcom (AVGO) added +3.67% — though all three are smaller weights, so their lift was meaningful but not transformative. Rocket Lab (RKLB) gained +2.79% and Expand Energy (EXE) +2.08%, both helpful, though RKLB carries an AVOID verdict and a QARP score of just 37.2 — the price moving the right direction doesn't fix a broken thesis. AstraZeneca (AZN) and S&P Global (SPGI) each added +1.33%. On the drag side, Abbott (ABT) — the book's largest single weight at 9.5% — slid –1.94% despite remaining in the green overall (+13.5% unrealized gain); an analyst forecast headline surfaced Tuesday but nothing that changes the yellow flag already on record around its trimmed EPS guide ahead of the Oct 21 print.

The drift problem is concentrated in the two biggest medical-device holdings. Boston Scientific (BSX) is down –13.9% in the book against a STRONG BUY verdict and a top-tier QARP of 81.4 — that's a widening gap between conviction and price, with guidance already slashed and the next catalyst not until Oct 28. Lululemon (LULU) is the starkest case: –26.8% unrealized, STRONG BUY rated, but carrying an elevated risk flag for a guidance cut, five straight quarters of negative Americas comps, tariff margin pressure, and a stalled China business. The model still believes; the market has been voting the other way for months.

Zoetis (ZTS) also deserves a second look — –9.4% in the book, STRONG BUY, but drifting quietly with no near-term catalyst identified to close the gap. Wednesday watch: BSX's flag clock is ticking toward Oct 28, ABT reports Oct 21, and the pharma cluster (GILD, NVS, NBIX, VRTX) faces a pricing-policy update Oct 22. The book needs those dates to deliver, not just hold.

attention.headline: –13.9% in the book, guidance already slashed, Oct 28 earnings closing fast
attention.note: Price and thesis are materially diverging — FY26 growth cut from 10.5% to 7–8.5%, management guiding flat through Q3, and the next reset opportunity is just three weeks away; the position needs a clear decision framework before that print.

attention.headline: –26.8% unrealized with an elevated risk flag and no near-term catalyst
attention.note: Five consecutive quarters of negative Americas comps, tariff-driven margin erosion, and a stalled China segment make the STRONG BUY verdict increasingly hard to defend at this drawdown level, with the next read not until Dec 9.

attention.headline: AVOID-rated name gaining ground and drawing whale-alert attention
attention.note: Today's +2.79% move and unusual institutional activity flagged in session headlines increase the risk that a drifting position becomes harder to exit at a reasonable level — the verdict and the price action are pointing in opposite directions.

attention.headline: Drug-pricing policy update due Oct 22 covers four pharma holdings
attention.note: The MFN pricing and tariff overhang affects GILD, NVS, NBIX, and VRTX simultaneously; Wednesday is the last full week to assess combined pharma exposure before that policy date arrives.
